name: vitals-strip
description: Unraid and Home Assistant health above the prompt: array and ZFS pools, CPU and memory, the Docker service, the Unraid integration's problem sensors (shelves, HBAs, optics), unread Unraid alerts, parity runs, and HA state, repairs and notifications. Unraid is read through the Unraid Management Agent integration in HA, in one read-only template call. Quiet by default: it shows only what isn't green. /vitals for the full strip.

haServer.title: Home Assistant MCP server
haServer.description: The HA-MCP connector's name as /mcp lists it, or its tool-name spelling (the part between mcp__ and __ha_). Both Unraid and HA are read through it; allow its ha_eval_template and ha_get_overview tools in permissions so auto mode doesn't review each read. Empty turns the strip off.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to read health; 0 reads only on /vitals.

quiet.title: Quiet
quiet.description: Show the band only when something isn't green.
